g.text: Initialization, preprocessing, component count and repeated samples answer different questions
A state label is credible only with a stability ledger
ARI comparisons use profile-matched k = 4 states on overlapping samples.
Suffix-derived pairs are descriptive because clinical visit timing is not distributed.
